tools.name: show_risk_map
tools.description: Shows an interactive map of a place in clients that render apps, such as Claude and ChatGPT: this week's forecast risk over the area, hazard events nearby as markers, and the risk by day, which the reader can pan, zoom and open full screen. Instead of the risk, the map can lay the precipitation, tem

tools.name: get_map_events
tools.description: The hazard events the interactive map loads when the reader pans or zooms to a new view. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the hazards near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: get_map_warnings
tools.description: The official warnings the interactive map draws over a view: each hazard's edge at each class and its symbols, at the view's zoom. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the warnings near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: get_map_event
tools.description: One hazard event the interactive map opens when the reader taps a warning's area or a storm's cone: the event, or none when it is no longer listed. The map calls it in clients that display it; to list the hazards near a place, use get_hazards_near.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Candidate coordinates for a place name or address, best match first, each with its full name and kind (city, state, road and so on).

Climate and disaster risk of one country, of 194, for ESG, investment, insurance and humanitarian screening: the overall risk score (0 to 100, higher is riskier), class and world rank, and the climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores and classes, with its region and income group.

tools.description:
Climate and disaster risk of two to ten named countries side by side: each one's overall risk score and class, its climate, nature, social, governance and adaptation scores, and its world rank by overall risk.

tools.name: rank_countries
tools.description:
The countries most or least at climate and disaster risk, overall or on one dimension (climate, nature, social, governance, adaptation), each with its score, risk class and rank, optionally only those in a region, subregion or income group.

Answers "which countries are most exposed to climate risk"

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "find_place" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
